stages.title: P2 · Product retrieval
stages.meaning: Rules preserve the original model identifier and rank dictionary candidates.
stages.next_step: Compare the original manufacturer, product name and identifiers with the dictionary candidates.

stages.title: P3 · Installed version
stages.meaning: Version evidence is recorded separately from product identity and CVE applicability.
stages.next_step: Supply the actual installed version/build and its inventory or update record.

stages.title: P4 · Product identity
stages.meaning: The selected dictionary identity passed the recorded evidence checks.
stages.next_step: Resolve the recorded name, manufacturer, identifier or component-type conflicts; retain competing products until supported.

diagnostics.candidate_scope: CISA links are product/advisory candidates, separate from NVD identity acceptance. They do not establish that the installed release is affected or fixed.
diagnostics.conclusion: Retrieved CVEs require product/version applicability and exploitability review.

result.identity_notice: Deterministic product/version/identifier checks; no identification model runs.
result.lookup_notice: Declared SBOM versions and ranges are compared with local product/version conditions. Full platform and AND/OR configuration applicability remains separate.

analysis_scope.explanation: Only entries in components were identified in this run. The representative asset CPE was not independently analyzed. Start a new run to apply the current asset analysis.
